tasks.scenario: The set dresser can't decide between the two wooden barrels for the tavern cellar. Put them side by side and pick the one you'd send back.
A shot puts the bronze whale statue on a desk. Check whether it's desk-sized or room-sized before you hand it off.
Pick one chandelier for a grand hallway out of everything the library has.
A storeroom needs a pile of moon rocks. Pick the rock that would read best as the hero piece.
Dress a medieval tavern table for a feast. Gather at least three props that belong on it.
The director likes the garden gnome but wants another small statue in the same spirit. Find one.
Layout wants either the Chinese armchair or the barber shop chair for a waiting room. Look at both together and choose.
Find a ladder a character could climb to reach a high shelf, and confirm it's tall enough next to a person.
You need one dining chair for a family kitchen. Look across the chairs and pick the best fit.
Fill a cluttered garage workshop. Gather at least three tools or fixtures for the workbench.
Build a rocky coastline at low tide. Gather at least three rock or cliff pieces that go together.
